===================================================================
0. FACTS ESTABLISHED FROM THE CODE (do not re-verify, do rely on)
===================================================================
- Environment: web/_includes/page_init.php lines 118-135 define G2ML_ENVIRONMENT from HTTP_HOST ('alpha' when the host starts with alpha., 'beta', 'local' for localhost/*.local, else 'production'); g2ml_getEnvironment() at line 152 wraps it. Neither exists in unit tests (page_init is not loaded there).
- Engine switch: web/_functions/pricing.php g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled() (line 609) reads 'billing.pricing_engine_enabled' through _g2ml_pricingSettingIsOn(); request-cached in $GLOBALS['g2ml_pricing_engine_enabled_cache']. g2ml_pricingMeterUsage() (line 1068) reads 'billing.usage_metering_enabled' the same way. entitlements.php's _g2ml_resolveOrgTier() (line 369) calls the engine only when g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled() is true; g2ml_featureAllowed()/g2ml_featureLimit() (lines 911/992) read the registry regardless of the switch through g2ml_pricingResolveOrgTier() (line 670).
- Resolver hole: _g2ml_pricingResolveFeatureValue() (pricing.php lines 401-584) treats a limit/quota row whose valueInt is NULL and isUnlimited is 0 as value null, and g2ml_featureLimit()/g2ml_pricingGetLimit() treat null as UNLIMITED. The schema (036, tblTierFeatures header) says NULL must never mean unlimited. This must be fixed before any boolean row is converted to a number (PF-02).
- Legacy path: _g2ml_fetchOrgTierRow()/_g2ml_fetchFallbackTierRow() (entitlements.php 159-215) read tblSubscriptionTiers columns maxLinks, maxCustomDomains, maxAPIRequestsPerDay, maxLinksPages, hasAdvancedRedirects, hasAnalytics, hasQRCodes, hasAPIAccess, hasPrioritySupport, hasCustomHTML. The fallback tier is the lowest-sortOrder ACTIVE tier. tblFeatures.legacyColumn maps registry rows to those columns (seed 018 lines 86-105). vwSubscriptionTierEntitlements (schema 036 line 1221) already emits the legacy-shaped values from the registry per tier.
- Pricing engine tables (schema 036): tblFeatures, tblPricePlans, tblTierFeatures (UNIQUE (tierID, featureUID, effectiveFromKey); undated row has effectiveFromKey '1000-01-01 00:00:00'), tblOrgFeatureOverrides (grant/deny/set/adjust, isActive, effective dates, sourceType, notes, createdByUserUID), tblCoupons, tblCouponRedemptions, tblSubscriptionPlans, tblUsageCounters, tblUsageCredits, tblUsageEvents. Nothing writes plans, coupons or overrides today.
- Registry rows today: seed 018 (legacy-mapped + granular, incl. analytics.retention_days limit default 30 with NO tier rows, analytics.geo_country boolean with NO tier rows) and seed 023 / migration 021 (LinksPage slugs, all boolean except linkspage.analytics_retention_days; tier rows for free/basic/premium/enterprise).
- Free tier seed (seed 001 line 31-39): 50 links, 0 domains, 100 API req/day, 1 page, hasAnalytics 0, hasAPIAccess 0, hasQRCodes 1. Link cap is enforced on ACTIVE links (web/Go2My.Link/_functions/shorturl_create.php lines 735-765, message hard-coded English at :761). hasAnalytics and hasAPIAccess are checked nowhere (grep confirms: only entitlements.php and pricing.php).
- Analytics: tblActivityLog (schema 030) holds per-click rows with ipAddress (NOT NULL), requestReferer, requestUserAgent, browserName, osName, deviceType, isBot, countryCode/regionCode/cityName. Redirect hot path web/G2My.Link/public_html/index.php lines 401-455: geolocation only inside the $shouldLog branch (DNT off and analytics.log_activity on), logActivity('redirect','success',...) then the clickCount UPDATE which runs even under DNT. Geolocation is recorded only when analytics.geolocation_enabled (System setting, seed 017 line 52, default off) is on AND the MaxMind file at analytics.geoip_db_path exists (g2ml_geolocationAvailable(), geolocation.php line 206).
- Retention: web/_functions/cron.php g2ml_cronRunRetentionJob() (line 673) gated by retention.enforcement_enabled (seeded '0'); anonymise sweep (line 756) blanks ipAddress to '0.0.0.0' and requestUserAgent to NULL after retention.activity_log_anonymise_days (seeded 90, clamp 0-3650); purge sweep (line 817) deletes rows after retention.activity_log_purge_days (seeded 0 = never). Country/region/city columns survive anonymisation. The endpoint web/Go2My.Link/_admin/public_html/cron.php is dead until #198 is fixed (other planner); the 1-in-500 page-load fallback (g2ml_cronMaybeRunProbabilisticRetention, line 1080) runs retention only. Job names: 'deletion' | 'retention' | 'all' (g2ml_cronNormaliseJobName, line 157).
- Privacy policy: web/Go2My.Link/public_html/pages/legal/privacy/index.php section 7 (lines 560-615) prints keys legal.privacy_s7_* from seed 010 lines 915-935; '90 days' and 'purged after 90 days' are hard-coded in the translation values. __() supports {placeholder} replacements (i18n.php line 257, str_replace at 316) and returns the key itself when a translation is missing. Translation seeds are INSERT IGNORE (never update existing values), so changed wording must use NEW keys. LP-11 (in flight) is editing this page; PF-12 lands after it.
- Admin conventions (copy them): pages live under web/Go2My.Link/_admin/public_html/pages/<route>/index.php and are found by resolveRoute() (nested folders work, e.g. org/domains). Auth: getCurrentUser(), hasMinimumRole($role, 'GlobalAdmin') (auth.php line 60: GlobalAdmin = 3). CSRF: g2ml_csrfField($formName) to render, g2ml_validateCSRFToken($_POST['_csrf_token'], $formName) to check; per-row forms MUST namespace the form name with the row id (#147; see api-keys/index.php lines 118-140). Forms: formField([...]) in web/_includes/accessibility.php (escapes once; pass raw values). Output: g2ml_sanitiseOutput(). Input: g2ml_sanitiseInput(). Transactions: $db = getDB(); $db->begin_transaction(); ... commit()/rollback() (data_rights.php lines 680-764). Strings: __('key') with a function_exists('__') fallback as every page does. Tests: tests/bootstrap.php gives test(), assert_true/false/same/contains; unit tests under tests/unit/*.php are DB-free; integration tests copy the DB_HOST guards from tests/integration/entitlements_test.php lines 60-80 and skip without a database.
- Migration house pattern: guarded ADD COLUMN via a throwaway stored procedure that checks information_schema (migration 016 lines 50-77); seeds and migrations idempotent (ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description-only, or INSERT IGNORE). CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml lines 254-272) imports schema, procedures, seeds in filename order and never migrations; the new mariadb-import.yml (FIX-183) does the same on MariaDB. So EVERY base schema/seed change ships with a numbered migration for existing databases.

===================================================================
2. ENVIRONMENT-AWARE ENGINE SWITCH (PF-01) — decision 6
===================================================================
New System setting billing.active_environments (string, seeded 'alpha', editable): a comma-separated list drawn from exactly alpha, beta, local, production. The engine is ON in a request only when BOTH billing.pricing_engine_enabled is on (existing) AND the current environment is in that list. The same two-part gate applies to billing.usage_metering_enabled (metering writes rows keyed by org into the shared database, so it must not run in an environment the owner did not list).
Functions (pricing.php):
  _g2ml_pricingCurrentEnvironment(): string — returns $GLOBALS['g2ml_pricing_environment_override'] when it is a string (test seam only); else g2ml_getEnvironment() when that function exists; else G2ML_ENVIRONMENT when defined; else ''.
  _g2ml_pricingEnvironmentAllowed(string $currentEnvironment, mixed $activeEnvironmentsSetting): bool — PURE. Non-string setting → false. Split on ',', trim, lowercase, keep only the four known names (anything else, including '*', is ignored, so a wildcard can never switch production on). Returns true only when $currentEnvironment is non-empty and in the kept list.
  g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled() = SettingIsOn(master) AND EnvironmentAllowed(current, ReadSetting('billing.active_environments', '')). When the master is on but the environment is not listed, write ONE error_log line per request ('pricing engine is switched on but this environment "<env>" is not in billing.active_environments — engine OFF here').
FAIL SAFE: unknown environment ('') → off; empty or malformed list → off; production must be spelled out to be included. The seeded 'alpha' means flipping the master switch on later can only affect the alpha site until the list is widened deliberately.
Test seam: tests that drive the engine ON must set $GLOBALS['g2ml_pricing_environment_override'] = 'alpha' and make their setting override return 'alpha' for 'billing.active_environments' (tests/unit/pricing_resolver_test.php and tests/unit/feature_gate_test.php currently use a single override callable; make it key-aware).

===================================================================
3. ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR TIER VALUES — decisions 2, 3, 5 (PF-03)
===================================================================
DECISION: the registry (tblFeatures + tblTierFeatures + tblOrgFeatureOverrides + tblPricePlans) is the source. The legacy columns on tblSubscriptionTiers (the ten has*/max* columns plus tierPriceMonthly/tierPriceAnnual) are a DERIVED COPY that the admin backend rewrites IN THE SAME TRANSACTION every time a registry value that maps to a legacy column changes. Chosen over "the legacy path reads the registry" because that would silently make the engine always-on in every environment, which contradicts decision 6. Exactly how:
- Setting a tier's value for a feature whose tblFeatures.legacyColumn is not NULL: INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE the UNDATED tblTierFeatures row (effectiveFrom NULL), then UPDATE tblSubscriptionTiers SET <legacyColumn> = <mapped value> WHERE tierID = ? in the same transaction. Mapping (PURE helper g2ml_tierAdminLegacyColumnValue): boolean → 0/1; limit/quota with isUnlimited=1 → NULL; limit/quota with a number → that number. The whitelist of legacy columns is exactly G2ML_ENTITLEMENT_FEATURE_FLAGS + G2ML_ENTITLEMENT_LIMIT_FIELDS (entitlements.php lines 119-139); any other legacyColumn value is refused before SQL is built (column names are never interpolated from user input).
- Saving a recurring GBP price plan for a tier that is isActive=1 and isDefault=1: billingInterval 'month' → tierPriceMonthly = amount; 'year' → tierPriceAnnual = amount; same transaction (only when the plan currency equals tblSubscriptionTiers.tierCurrency).
- tierName, tierDescription, sortOrder, isActive are edited on tblSubscriptionTiers directly (they have no registry twin). tierID is immutable once created.
- Creating a tier writes explicit legacy columns of 0 (max* = 0, has* = 0, prices 0.00) AND one undated tblTierFeatures row per legacy-mapped feature with value 0 / off, so a new tier grants nothing on either path until configured. (NULL max* would mean unlimited on the legacy path.)
- Drift check g2ml_tierAdminFindDrift(): compares tblSubscriptionTiers columns with vwSubscriptionTierEntitlements per active tier per legacy column; returns the list of differences. The admin index shows a warning banner when non-empty, with a CSRF-protected "Repair" button that copies registry → columns (g2ml_tierAdminRepairLegacyColumns, audited). Also flags any (tier, feature) pair that has DATED tblTierFeatures rows, because the admin screens edit only the undated row and a dated row would shadow it.
- Scheduling (effectiveFrom/effectiveUntil) and enum/config features are NOT editable in this admin (read-only display, plain note). Stated limitation.
- Every write: audit row (section 4), then g2ml_clearPricingCache() (clears both caches).
- Retiring a tier: isActive=0. Refused when it is the lowest-sortOrder active tier (it is the fallback plan every unknown org resolves to) or when organisations are on it unless a replacement active tier is given, in which case UPDATE tblOrganisations SET tierID = replacement WHERE tierID = retired runs in the same transaction and the audit row records the count moved. Tiers are never deleted.
- Feature registry: create (slug pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$, max 100; valueType boolean|limit|quota; unit; quotaPeriod for quota; category; description; sortOrder; showOnPricingPage; defaults: boolean 0, limit/quota 0 or defaultIsUnlimited), edit name/description/unit/sortOrder/isActive/showOnPricingPage, and a guarded type conversion boolean→limit (section 5 rule) in one transaction. valueType can never be changed any other way; slug and legacyColumn can never be edited.
- New column tblFeatures.showOnPricingPage TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 (schema 036 edit + guarded ADD COLUMN in migration 030). Migration 030 and seed 018 set it to 0 for redirects.advanced (umbrella), clicks.tracked_per_month and qr.scans_per_month (metering dimensions).

===================================================================
4. AUDIT LOG (PF-03) — decision 5
===================================================================
New table tblTierAdminAudit (schema 038_tier_admin_audit.sql; migration 030): auditUID BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PK; actorUserUID BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL FK tblUsers ON DELETE SET NULL; actionType VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL (tier.create, tier.rename, tier.reorder, tier.retire, tier.reactivate, feature.create, feature.update, feature.convert, tier_feature.set, org_override.create, org_override.deactivate, price_plan.create, price_plan.update, coupon.create, coupon.update, legacy.repair, setting.update); targetType VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL; targetKey VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL; beforeJSON JSON NULL; afterJSON JSON NULL (row snapshots, column → scalar); note TEXT NULL; environment VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL; createdAt DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; INDEX (createdAt), INDEX (targetType, targetKey), INDEX (actorUserUID). Rows are never updated or deleted and are not touched by any retention sweep (no personal data beyond the acting admin's user id). g2ml_tierAdminWriteAudit() is called INSIDE the caller's transaction on the same connection, so a change and its audit row commit or roll back together; a failed audit insert rolls the change back (a change without a record is refused). Each write also calls logActivity('tier_admin_change', 'success', 200, ['logData' => ['auditUID' => ..., 'actionType' => ...]]) for the existing activity trail; web/_schemas/database/activity-log-data.schema.json documents the two keys and web/_schemas/database/tier-admin-audit-snapshot.schema.json documents the snapshot envelope.

===================================================================
5. QUANTITY-CAPABLE FEATURES — decision 4 (PF-02) — FULL SLUG LIST
===================================================================
Final registry after PF-02. Types: B = boolean (g2ml_featureAllowed), L = limit (g2ml_featureLimit; null = unlimited), Q = quota per month (g2ml_featureLimit against this month's count; meterable). Values Free / Basic / Premium / Enterprise. Legacy-mapped rows keep their legacy column.
LinksPage:
  linkspage.pages_max            L pages (per ORGANISATION; legacy maxLinksPages)  1 / 3 / 10 / unlimited   (unchanged)
  linkspage.pages_per_member     L pages (per MEMBER, NEW)                          1 / 1 / 3 / unlimited    (enforce: both pages_max and pages_per_member must allow; planner 2 LP-22/#239)
  linkspage.all_templates        B (full template library; starter set is free)     no / yes / yes / yes     (CHANGED from yes for Free, decision 13)
  linkspage.template_upload      B (NEW; uploaded templates, ships behind a kill switch) no / no / yes / yes
  linkspage.custom_html          B (legacy hasCustomHTML)                            no / no / yes / yes
  linkspage.agegate              B                                                   yes / yes / yes / yes
  linkspage.custom_domain        B                                                   no / yes / yes / yes
  linkspage.hide_branding        B                                                   no / yes / yes / yes
  linkspage.seo                  B                                                   no / yes / yes / yes
  linkspage.click_tracking       B                                                   yes / yes / yes / yes
  linkspage.analytics_retention_days L days                                          30 / 90 / 365 / unlimited
  linkspage.scheduled_links      L links per PAGE (CONVERTED from B)                 0 / 5 / 25 / unlimited
  linkspage.password_protect     L password-protected pages per ORGANISATION (CONVERTED) 0 / 0 / 3 / unlimited
  linkspage.image_upload         L stored images per ORGANISATION (CONVERTED)        0 / 10 / 100 / unlimited  (per-file size is a System setting, planner 2)
  linkspage.embeds               L embeds per PAGE (CONVERTED)                       0 / 0 / 10 / unlimited
  linkspage.tracking_pixels      L pixels per PAGE (CONVERTED)                       0 / 0 / 3 / unlimited
  linkspage.lead_capture         Q captures per MONTH (CONVERTED; isMeterable 1, quotaPeriod month) 0 / 0 / 500 / unlimited
  linkspage.verified_badge       B (may REQUEST verification; never grants it)       no / no / yes / yes
Analytics (short links):
  analytics.enabled              B (legacy hasAnalytics)                             yes / yes / yes / yes    (Free CHANGED to yes, decision 1 — PF-08)
  analytics.retention_days       L days viewable (NEW tier rows)                     30 / 90 / 365 / unlimited
  analytics.geo_country          B country breakdown visible (NEW tier rows)         no / yes / yes / yes
  analytics.export_csv           B (tier rows NEW)                                   yes / yes / yes / yes
Everything else in seed 018 is unchanged.
Conversion rule for an existing boolean row (migration 028, one transaction per slug, idempotent): UPDATE tblFeatures SET valueType='limit' (or 'quota' + quotaPeriod='month' + isMeterable=1 for lead_capture), valueUnit=<unit>, defaultValueBoolean=NULL, defaultValueInt=0, defaultIsUnlimited=0 WHERE featureSlug=? AND valueType='boolean'; then UPDATE tblTierFeatures tf JOIN tblFeatures f USING (featureUID) SET tf.valueInt = CASE tf.tierID WHEN 'free' THEN <free> WHEN 'basic' THEN <basic> WHEN 'premium' THEN <premium> ELSE <premium> END, tf.isUnlimited = CASE WHEN tf.tierID='enterprise' AND <enterprise is unlimited> THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tf.valueBoolean = NULL WHERE f.featureSlug=? AND tf.valueBoolean IS NOT NULL AND tf.valueInt IS NULL (only rows still in boolean shape are touched; a 0 stays 0; a 1 on an owner-created tier becomes the Premium number, never unlimited, so nothing is silently opened). For enterprise: valueInt NULL, isUnlimited 1. Seed 023 is EDITED so fresh installs create the rows in their final shape.
Resolver fix (pricing.php _g2ml_pricingResolveFeatureValue, all three stages): for limit/quota, valueInt NULL with isUnlimited 0 → 0 (with one error_log line at the tier and override stages, since it is a mis-shaped row), never null. Seed 018 + migration 028 set defaultValueInt = 0 where a limit/quota registry row has NULL and defaultIsUnlimited = 0. Consequence stated in comments: "unlimited" is ONLY isUnlimited = 1.
Callers: after PF-02, code must use g2ml_featureLimit() for every L/Q slug (g2ml_featureAllowed() on a limit logs and returns false, fail closed). Planner 2's LP-07 (#225) must therefore call g2ml_featureLimit($org, 'linkspage.scheduled_links', $scheduledCountOnThisPage) and treat ['allowed'] === false as "not on your plan / limit reached". No builder edits seed 023 except PF-02.

===================================================================
6. ANALYTICS COUNTS KEPT FOR EVER — decisions 1, 7, 8 (PF-09/10/11/12)
===================================================================
Table tblAnalyticsDaily (schema 039; migration 031): statUID PK; statDate DATE NOT NULL (UTC day); orgHandle VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' (no FK — counts outlive an organisation; they contain no personal data); subjectType ENUM('shorturl','linkspage') NOT NULL; subjectRef VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL (shortCode, or the pageUID as text); eventType VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL ('click' = human click, 'bot_click', and for LinksPages 'view', 'item_click'); dimension VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'total' ('total','country','device','referrer','browser','os','item'); dimensionValue VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' ('' for total; 'unknown' when not known; 'direct' for no referrer); eventCount BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; createdAt/updatedAt. UNIQUE KEY UQ_analytics_daily (subjectType, subjectRef, statDate, eventType, dimension, dimensionValue); INDEX (orgHandle, statDate); INDEX (subjectType, subjectRef, statDate). Never touched by any retention sweep or by account anonymisation.
WRITTEN ON THE HOT PATH, not by a job: web/_functions/analytics_daily.php g2ml_analyticsDailyRecord(array $facts): bool builds the day's rows with the PURE g2ml_analyticsDailyBuildRows() and runs ONE multi-row INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE eventCount = eventCount + 1, wrapped in try/catch, gated by System setting analytics.daily_counts_enabled (seeded '1'); a failure is logged and never blocks the redirect. Chosen over a job because periodic work on this host is still not wired (#178, #198) and the counts must exist from day one. Referrer is reduced to its host (PURE g2ml_analyticsDailyReferrerHost); country comes from the geolocation already computed for the log row (recorded for every plan whenever geolocation is on — viewing it is what the plan gates); device/browser/os from _g2ml_parseUserAgent() (activity_logger.php line 334). Under Do-Not-Track (or analytics.log_activity off) only the 'total' row is written — the same reasoning as the clickCount update that already runs under DNT — so no lookup on the visitor's IP happens for a DNT visitor. Bots (isBot = 1) count only as eventType 'bot_click' total. Component B call site: web/G2My.Link/public_html/index.php immediately after the clickCount UPDATE (line ~445), passing the geo values already in scope when $shouldLog was true.
Planner 2 SHOULD use g2ml_analyticsDailyRecord() with subjectType 'linkspage' (eventType 'view' / 'item_click', dimension 'item' = itemUID) for LP-05/LP-06 instead of a separate tblLinksPageStats; schema 037 then stays unused, which is fine.
BACKFILL of history: cron.php gains job 'aggregate' (accepted by g2ml_cronNormaliseJobName; 'all' runs deletion, aggregate, retention in that order). g2ml_cronRunAggregateJob() is gated by analytics.daily_counts_backfill_enabled (seeded '0'); it rolls tblActivityLog redirect rows (logAction='redirect', logStatus='success') into tblAnalyticsDaily one whole UTC day at a time, from the day after analytics.daily_counts_backfilled_through (or the oldest logged day) up to the day BEFORE analytics.daily_counts_started_on (set by seed 036 / migration 031 to CURRENT_DATE through INSERT ... SELECT, so install day is the first hot-path day), using INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE eventCount = VALUES(eventCount) (replace semantics → idempotent), then advances the watermark with setSetting(). It never touches days on or after started_on (the hot path owns those). Pre-cutover counts are the LOGGED clicks (DNT visitors were never logged); stated in the docs.
PURGE GUARD: g2ml_retentionPurgeActivityLog() may delete a row only if its day is >= started_on (already counted live) OR <= backfilled_through (rolled up). Rows in the gap are kept until the backfill reaches them. Also the anonymise sweep now reduces requestReferer to its host in the same UPDATE, and migration 031 does the one-off trim for rows anonymised before this change.
IP REMOVAL: unchanged mechanism (retention.activity_log_anonymise_days, seeded 90, configurable); countryCode/regionCode/cityName stay (decision 7). What must be on for geo to be recorded: analytics.geolocation_enabled = 1 AND a readable MaxMind file at analytics.geoip_db_path (that is all; nothing per plan). Purge stays 0 (rows kept without identifiers) unless the owner changes it.
VIEW WINDOW PER PLAN (PF-10): PURE g2ml_analyticsClampRangeToWindow(string $from, string $to, ?int $windowDays, string $nowUtc): array{from,to,clamped,earliestAllowed}; window = g2ml_featureLimit($orgHandle, 'analytics.retention_days', 0)['limit'] (null = no clamp; '[default]' org and GlobalAdmin are never gated, as today). Applied in the dashboard (plain note + upgrade text when clamped), analytics-export.php and the API v1 analytics handler (response meta gains clamped/earliestAllowed; no error). Country breakdown shown only when g2ml_featureAllowed($org, 'analytics.geo_country').
DASHBOARD LONG-TERM SOURCE (PF-11): analytics_daily.php read functions mirror analytics.php's four aggregates over tblAnalyticsDaily; the dashboard uses them when analytics.dashboard_use_daily_counts (seeded '0') is on; the unique-IP tile is then replaced by a note (aggregates have no IPs).
PRIVACY POLICY (PF-12): new translation keys (INSERT IGNORE, old keys left in place) with placeholders filled from the SAME settings the job reads: legal.privacy_retention_clicks_notes ('Detailed click records keep the visitor's IP address and browser details for {ip_days} days; after that the IP address and browser string are removed and only the country, device type and daily counts remain.'), _pending variant when retention.enforcement_enabled is off ('...will be removed after {ip_days} days once automated clean-up is switched on; until then they are kept'), legal.privacy_retention_activity_kept / _purged ({purge_days}), legal.privacy_retention_counts ('Daily counts contain no personal data and are kept indefinitely.'), legal.privacy_retention_urls ('An expired short link stops working immediately and stays in your account until you delete it.'), legal.privacy_retention_account ({grace_days} from compliance.data_deletion_grace_days), legal.privacy_retention_exports ({export_hours}). PURE g2ml_privacyRetentionReplacements(array $facts) chooses the variant and the numbers. The wording is flagged for the legal review (decision 8) in PRE_LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md, together with "retention.enforcement_enabled must be ON at launch".

7. PUBLIC PRICING PAGE FROM DATA (PF-07)
===================================================================
pricing.php gains g2ml_pricingResolveTierFeatures(string $tierID): array|false (features + the tier's currently-effective rows, NO org overrides, ignores the switch, request-cached) and PURE g2ml_pricingFormatMoney(string $amount, string $currency): string ('£4.99', '€', '$', otherwise 'GBP 4.99'; 0.00 → 'Free'). Plans: active, visible, recurring, currency = billing.default_currency, region NULL; prefer isDefault=1 then lowest sortOrder; fall back to tierPriceMonthly/tierPriceAnnual when no plan exists. Matrix: features isActive=1 AND showOnPricingPage=1, grouped by category, ordered by sortOrder; label = __('pricing.feature.' . slug) when that key has a translation (the helper compares the returned string with the key), else featureName. Cells: yes/no with visually hidden text, numbers, 'Unlimited', quotas 'N a month'. Every CTA goes to /register until billing exists (#59). No hard-coded tier or feature text remains.

===================================================================
8. FAIL-SAFE RULES THAT APPLY TO EVERY ITEM
===================================================================
- Admin writes: refuse on any validation failure; transactions; audit row or nothing; CSRF on every form (namespaced per row); GlobalAdmin checked on the server on every request (never only in the menu); all output escaped once; all strings via __().
- Reads on the public/hot path: never throw; a failure logs and degrades (pricing page falls back to tier columns if the registry read fails; the daily counter never blocks a redirect).
- Limits: a missing number is 0, "unlimited" is only the explicit flag. Yes/no extras fail closed (existing rule). Legacy has*/max* keep the existing fail-open contract.
- Environment: anything not recognised means the engine is OFF.

9. COMMENTS TO POST ON EXISTING ISSUES (lead posts these verbatim)
===================================================================
#180: "Planned on 2026-09-21 under the owner's decisions (#243, decision 6): the master switch becomes environment-aware. A new setting billing.active_environments (seeded 'alpha') lists where the engine may run, and the engine is on only where both it and billing.pricing_engine_enabled say so, so switching it on for the alpha site cannot touch production on the shared database. BINDING LINKSPAGE DESIGN (planner 2 of 3). Verified against the code on branch feat/2026-09-21-linkspage-and-sweep on 2026-09-21. It builds on planner 1's platform design (PF-01..PF-12), which stays binding. Builders follow this exactly; where an item plan and this design disagree, this design wins and the builder stops and asks the lead. =================================================================== 0. FACTS ESTABLISHED FROM THE CODE (rely on them; do not re-verify) =================================================================== - Pages belong to a USER (tblLinksPages.userUID; every manage function binds userUID = ? in SQL). tblLinksPages.orgHandle is copied from getCurrentUser()['orgHandle'] at create time (create/index.php line 78) and is never updated afterwards. - New sign-ups sit in the '[default]' organisation (auth.php line 333). entitlements.php _g2ml_resolveOrgTier() returns the unlimited sentinel for '[default]' (source 'default_org'), and g2ml_featureAllowed() / g2ml_featureLimit() pass that straight through. Result today: every individual account gets unlimited LinksPages and every LinksPage extra. An empty orgHandle '' has no tblOrganisations row, so it resolves to the fallback (lowest sortOrder, active) tier, which is Free. - g2ml_featureAllowed() FAILS CLOSED (a system error, an unknown slug or a non-boolean all give false). g2ml_featureLimit() FAILS OPEN (a system error or an unknown slug give allowed/unlimited). This is documented in entitlements.php lines 880-1082. - Public render path on lnks.page: web/Lnks.page/public_html/index.php, Step 7 (slug shape check), Step 8 (g2ml_resolveLinksPage), Step 8.5 (whole-page age gate, CSRF form name 'linkspage_agegate_confirm_' . $slug, POST/redirect/GET to '/' . rawurlencode($slug)), Step 9 (logActivity linkspage_view), Step 9.5 (strict CSP for custom HTML). - The custom-domain fallback, web/G2My.Link/_functions/linkspage_fallback.php g2ml_renderCustomDomainLinksPageFallback(), calls g2ml_resolveLinksPageByUID() and echoes g2ml_renderLinksPage() with NO age gate (#229). It is reached from web/G2My.Link/public_html/index.php on the empty-code branch (line ~227) and on the not_found branch, for any request method. Component B's .htaccess CSP is `img-src 'self' data:` with `Header setifempty`, so images are blocked there even after LP-10. The default avatar '/img/logo.png' exists in both web roots. - The renderer (web/Lnks.page/_functions/linkspage_renderer.php) substitutes 7 placeholders in g2ml_linkspageApplyTemplate() (line 561): {{avatar}} {{name}} {{bio}} {{links}} {{social}} {{theme}} {{background}}. {{name}} is ALSO used inside alt="{{name}}", so HTML must never be put in the name value. g2ml_linkspageBuildDocument() (line 592) hard-codes lang="en", robots "index, follow" and has no canonical tag. - Templates (seed 004): slugs default, modern, minimal, bold, professional. Each has `

{{name}}

` and the anchor `Powered by Lnks.page` (lines 53/81/109/137/167). Upsert: ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE templateName, updatedAt. modern uses an inline style attribute with {{background}}/{{theme}}. The resolver only ever loads isSystem = 1 templates (resolver lines 306-356). - Manage layer (web/_functions/linkspage_manage.php): Create binds 'isssssisssisi' (line 1213), Update binds 'ssssisssisiii' (line 1331), with column-by-column comments; any new column must extend both the SQL and the commented mapping. AddItem/UpdateItem return ['success','itemUID','error'] with NO errorCode. The page-limit count is per USER (g2ml_linkspageManageCountActivePagesForUser, line 819) against g2ml_checkLimit($orgHandle, 'maxLinksPages'). G2ML_LINKSPAGE_RESERVED_SLUGS (line 354) has 17 words and 'media' is NOT among them; the resolver keeps a twin list, G2ML_LINKSPAGE_RESOLVER_RESERVED_SLUGS. - The owner preview (pages/linkspage/preview/index.php) feeds g2ml_linkspageManageListItemsForPage(), which lists ALL items including inactive ones, into g2ml_linkspageBuildOwnerPreviewModel() (#230). - Uploads: G2ML_UPLOADS = web/_uploads (page_init.php line 106). It is outside every web root, excluded from every deploy mirror phase (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, "Paths the mirror never touches"), shared by every channel (like the database), and **/_uploads/* is git-ignored. - Helpers to reuse: g2ml_lookupDnsTxtRecords() (org.php line 956, test seam $GLOBALS['g2ml_dns_txt_lookup_override']); g2ml_sendEmail($to, $subject, $template, $data) (email.php line 76) with templates in web/_includes/email_templates/.php; g2ml_encrypt()/g2ml_decrypt() (security.php 66/128); g2ml_generateToken() (1260); g2ml_sanitiseEmail() (958); g2ml_getClientIP() (1163); g2ml_hashPassword()/g2ml_verifyPassword() (232/262); g2ml_linkspageCustomHtmlCSP() and g2ml_sanitiseUserHTML()/g2ml_sanitiseUserCSS() (html_sanitiser.php); the age-gate token pattern (adult_content.php 269-433, HMAC with ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECONDARY, host-only cookie). - Rate limiting exists only for the API (tblAPIRequestLog) and login (tblUsers columns). logActivity() returns early for Do-Not-Track visitors (activity_logger.php line 96), so the activity log can NEVER be used to count attempts: a visitor could bypass the limit just by sending DNT. - No test checks that __() keys are seeded. No JSON schema exists for tblLinksPages.socialLinks. =================================================================== 1. HOW EVERY LINKSPAGE FEATURE ASKS "IS THIS ON THE PLAN?" (LP-27) =================================================================== New file web/_functions/linkspage_plan.php (functions only), loaded by page_init.php immediately after linkspage_manage.php with a guarded require_once, and require_once'd by the resolver/renderer entry points when page_init is absent (unit tests). - g2ml_linkspageGateOrgHandle(?string $pageOrgHandle): string. NULL or '' → ''. '[default]' → '' (so an individual account resolves to the fallback Free tier). Anything else → unchanged. This implements owner question 1 as recommended; if the owner says no, only the '[default]' branch changes. The GlobalAdmin acting context is still unlimited, because _g2ml_resolveOrgTier() checks it for any handle. - g2ml_linkspageFeatureAllowed(?string $pageOrgHandle, string $slug): bool = g2ml_featureAllowed(g2ml_linkspageGateOrgHandle($pageOrgHandle), $slug). FAIL CLOSED. - g2ml_linkspageFeatureQuota(?string $pageOrgHandle, string $slug, int $currentCount): array = g2ml_featureLimitStrict(g2ml_linkspageGateOrgHandle(...), $slug, $currentCount). FAIL CLOSED. It is used for every CONVERTED LinksPage number: scheduled_links, password_protect, image_upload, embeds, lead_capture. - Ordinary limits that must fail open keep using g2ml_checkLimit / g2ml_featureLimit through the gate org: linkspage.pages_max (legacy maxLinksPages), linkspage.pages_per_member, and the history windows linkspage.analytics_retention_days / analytics.retention_days. - entitlements.php gains g2ml_featureLimitStrict(string $orgHandle, string $slug, int $count): array{allowed, limit, remaining, reason}. It returns the same answers as g2ml_featureLimit(), EXCEPT: resolver false → ['allowed'=>false,'limit'=>0,'remaining'=>0,'reason'=>'system_error']; unknown or inactive slug → reason 'unknown_feature'; non-int, non-null value → reason 'wrong_type'. Each writes one error_log line. Unlimited or '[default]'/GlobalAdmin → allowed, limit null, reason 'unlimited'; a normal answer → reason 'ok'. It must share the comparison with g2ml_featureLimit() by extracting a private helper _g2ml_featureLimitCompare(int $limit, int $count): array, so the two can never disagree. - Counting scope (the "per organisation" rule, #243 decision 12). g2ml_linkspageScopeSql(?string $pageOrgHandle, int $ownerUserUID, string $tableAlias): array{sql, types, params}. When the gate org is '' the scope is the owner's own pages that have no real org: ".userUID = ? AND (.orgHandle IS NULL OR .orgHandle = '[default]')". Otherwise ".orgHandle = ?". The alias is checked against ^[a-z]{1,3}$ before it is put into SQL. Every per-organisation count (pages, password pages, stored images, email captures) uses it. - One central place per page model: resolver function g2ml_linkspageDecorateModel(array $model, string $context): array, with $context 'public' or 'preview'. It is called at the END of _g2ml_linkspageBuildPublicModelFromRow() and of g2ml_linkspageBuildOwnerPreviewModel(). LP-27 creates it; it sets $model['page']['gateOrgHandle']. Each later feature adds its render-time gate INSIDE it as one clearly headed block, so the public page and the preview can never apply different rules. Render gates only ever REMOVE or NEUTRALISE stored values. The only exceptions are the ones that fail safe: a stored schedule is always honoured, and a stored password always locks. =================================================================== 2. PUBLIC REQUEST PIPELINE (LP-14) — one routine for lnks.page and custom domains =================================================================== New file web/Lnks.page/_functions/linkspage_public.php: g2ml_linkspagePublicHandle(array $pageModel, array $ctx): array{outcome, status} where $ctx = ['surface' => 'lnkspage'|'custom_domain', 'selfPath' => '/' or '/', 'slug' => string, 'method' => 'GET'|'POST'|..., 'clickItemUID' => int (0 = none), 'leadAction' => '' | 'confirm' | 'unsubscribe', 'leadToken' => '' ]. It never calls exit(); the two callers do. It emits headers and echoes the body. The outcome is one of 'rendered', 'redirected', 'interstitial', 'not_found' or 'locked'. Fixed order of steps. Later items add their step at the named slot; they never reorder: 1. method/route dispatch: lead confirm or unsubscribe (LP-18), click-through (LP-05); 2. password unlock POST and lock screen (LP-13); 3. age gate: confirm POST, then interstitial; 4. email sign-up POST (LP-18); 5. counting a view (LP-05); 6. security policy header via g2ml_linkspagePublicCSP($model, $ctx); 7. cache headers (LP-26); 8. render. CSRF form names are keyed by pageUID, not slug. The redirect target is always $ctx['selfPath'] (never user input). g2ml_linkspagePublicBaseURL(): string lives in the resolver. On component C it returns the request's own 'https://' . host when the host matches ^([a-z0-9-]+\.)?lnks\.page$; otherwise it returns System/Default setting linkspage.public_base_url (seeded 'https://lnks.page'); rtrim '/'. Every absolute LinksPage URL uses it: click-through links, media, canonical tags, confirmation links and the default avatar on a custom domain. =================================================================== 3. TEMPLATE SLOTS (LP-03 adds them all at once) =================================================================== Three new placeholders go into every system template in ONE migration (022), so later features never touch template HTML again: - {{badges}} goes immediately after `

{{name}}

`; - {{capture}} goes immediately before `
`; - {{branding}} replaces the Powered-by anchor. The renderer substitutes '' for {{badges}} and {{capture}} until LP-17/LP-32 and LP-18 fill them. Fail safe: if a template lacks a placeholder and the content for it is non-empty, the content is appended just before the end of the body. LP-24 adds colour placeholders {{on_theme}} (black or white text chosen for readability on the accent) and {{on_background}}. New templates (LP-21) must use all twelve placeholders. User templates (LP-29) get colours only as CSS custom properties (--lp-theme, --lp-background, --lp-on-theme, --lp-on-background) that the renderer defines itself, never as {{…}} inside user CSS. =================================================================== 4. MEDIA (LP-16, LP-28) =================================================================== Files are stored at G2ML_UPLOADS/linkspage//<32 hex>., recorded in tblLinksPageMedia (schema 041), re-encoded with GD, and served ONLY through the lnks.page route /media//<32hex>.. That route is an .htaccess rewrite to index.php?media_page=&media_file=, handled before any slug logic. Stored references are the relative path '/media//'. The renderer turns such a value into g2ml_linkspagePublicBaseURL() . path, so it works on custom domains too. 'media' is added to both reserved-slug lists. Deleting a page (manage delete and GDPR erasure) deletes its files FIRST, through g2ml_linkspageMediaDeleteAllForPage(). After LP-28 the renderer ignores any absolute external image URL, and the policy becomes img-src 'self' data:. =================================================================== 5. SECURITY POLICY (CSP) FROM PHP ON BOTH SURFACES =================================================================== g2ml_linkspagePublicCSP(array $model, array $ctx): string (renderer) returns: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src ; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src <'none' or the embed origins>; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'. - img-src is "'self' https: data:" until LP-28, then "'self' data:". - frame-src lists ONLY the provider origins of embeds actually expanded in this response (LP-20). - A page that uses custom HTML or a user template keeps the stricter g2ml_linkspageCustomHtmlCSP(). - Both .htaccess files keep `Header setifempty`, so the PHP header wins for that one response. =================================================================== 6. STATISTICS (LP-05, LP-06) — no separate table =================================================================== Written with planner 1's g2ml_analyticsDailyRecord() (PF-09), with subjectType 'linkspage', subjectRef = (string) pageUID, orgHandle = the page's orgHandle or ''. - Page view: eventType 'view'. - Item click: eventType 'item_click' plus extraRows [['item_click','item',(string) itemUID]]. - detailAllowed = g2ml_shouldTrack(). countryCode comes from g2ml_geolocateIP(g2ml_getClientIP()) only when detailAllowed and g2ml_geolocationAvailable(). - Bots (_g2ml_parseUserAgent isBot = 1) are NOT counted at all on LinksPages. - Under DNT only the total row and the item row are written; the item row describes the link, not the visitor. - Schema 037 and migration 026 stay unused (reserved earlier; do not reuse them). Reading: web/_functions/linkspage_stats.php (LP-06) queries tblAnalyticsDaily with subjectType/subjectRef in SQL. The window comes from linkspage.analytics_retention_days through the gate org (g2ml_featureLimit, null = all) and planner 1's pure g2ml_analyticsClampRangeToWindow() (PF-10). =================================================================== 7. KILL SWITCHES (operator settings, scope 'Default', ALL SEEDED '0' unless stated) =================================================================== - linkspage.click_tracking_enabled '1' (LP-05) - linkspage.uploads_enabled '1' (LP-16; uploads also switch off when GD is missing) - linkspage.embeds_enabled '1' (LP-20) - linkspage.user_templates_enabled '0' (LP-29, until the security review and #207) - linkspage.verification_requests_enabled '0' (LP-32, until the owner approves docs/VERIFICATION_POLICY.md) - linkspage.lead_capture_enabled '0' (LP-18, until legal approves the wording) - linkspage.public_cache_seconds '60' (LP-26; 0 = off) Every switch is read with the same truthy rule as g2ml_linkspageCustomHtmlKillSwitchEnabled() (true, 1, '1', 'true', 'yes', 'on'). Anything else, a missing settings layer, or an error means OFF (fail closed). =================================================================== 8. FAIL-SAFE RULES FOR EVERY ITEM =================================================================== - Gate at SAVE time (manage layer, using the PAGE's orgHandle through the gate helpers) AND at RENDER time (g2ml_linkspageDecorateModel). An admin-screen check only decides whether to show a locked note. - Optional extras fail closed. A downgrade takes effect on the next view, with no clean-up job. The exceptions: a stored schedule is always honoured, and a stored password always locks. - Never redirect to anything except a stored item URL that passes g2ml_linkspageSanitiseHref() at the moment of the redirect. - Visitor-facing POSTs (unlock, age confirm, sign-up) are CSRF-checked and rate-limited through tblLinksPageAttempts. Every "no" message is generic and never reveals whether an email address or password is known. - No raw IP address is stored by any LinksPage item. The attempts table stores hash_hmac('sha256', ip, key . '|lp-attempt'), using the ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECONDARY constant as the key (defined in auth_creds; builders must use the constant, never a literal), and its rows are purged after 24 hours. - Personal data that visitors give us (email capture) is encrypted with g2ml_encrypt and looked up by a keyed hash. It is covered by data export and deletion, and deleted automatically. - Every user-visible string goes through __() with a function_exists fallback and is seeded in that item's translation seed. Every new admin page checks getCurrentUser() and ownership on the server. Per-row forms namespace their CSRF name with the row id (#147). formField() gets RAW values (LP-12). No web address ends in .php. =================================================================== 9. SEEDS AND MIGRATIONS RULE (as the repository already does it) =================================================================== - A NEW seed file (settings with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description-only, translations with INSERT IGNORE, registry rows with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description-only / INSERT IGNORE tier rows) is applied to existing databases as-is, and its header says so (precedent: seeds 022 and 029). - A NEW table, a NEW or changed column, or an EDIT to an existing seed file (004) ALWAYS ships with a numbered, guarded, re-runnable migration, in the house pattern: a throwaway procedure checking information_schema, as in migration 016 lines 50-77; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; UPDATEs guarded with NOT LIKE / IS NULL. - CI imports schema, procedures and seeds, never migrations. So every base change must also be in the schema or seed file. - Only PF-02 edits seed 023. A NEW registry slug (only LP-17's linkspage.website_check) goes in the item's own new seed. =================================================================== 10. NUMBERS (reserved; do not renumber) =================================================================== - Already reserved first-batch numbers, used as planned: migration 022 LP-03, 023 LP-08, 024 LP-04, 025 LP-07; seed 024 LP-03, 025 LP-04, 026 LP-07, 027 LP-05, 028 LP-06. - Released and left unused: migration 026 and schema 037 (statistics now use tblAnalyticsDaily). - New migrations: 032 LP-27, 033 LP-24, 034 LP-13, 035 LP-16, 036 LP-20, 037 LP-21, 038 LP-29, 039 LP-17, 040 LP-32, 041 LP-18. - New seeds: 040 LP-14, 041 LP-22, 042 LP-24, 043 LP-13, 044 LP-16, 045 LP-28, 046 LP-20, 047 LP-21, 048 LP-29, 049 LP-17, 050 LP-32, 051 LP-18, 052 LP-31, 053 LP-23, 054 LP-26, 055 LP-30, 056 LP-15. - New schema: 040 LP-27 (tblLinksPageAttempts), 041 LP-16 (tblLinksPageMedia), 042 LP-32 (tblLinksPageVerificationRequests), 043 LP-18 (tblLinksPageLeads). - NEXT FREE FOR PLANNER 3: migration 042, seed 057, schema 044. =================================================================== 11. DEPENDENCIES ON PLANNER 1 (assumed to land as written) =================================================================== - PF-02: converted slugs, linkspage.pages_per_member, linkspage.template_upload, all_templates off for Free, and "a blank limit means 0". Needed by LP-07, LP-13, LP-16, LP-20, LP-21, LP-22, LP-29 and LP-18. - PF-09: g2ml_analyticsDailyRecord and the extraRows behaviour. Needed by LP-05. - PF-10: g2ml_analyticsClampRangeToWindow. Needed by LP-06. - PF-04: the /platform admin index. Needed by LP-32. - If PF-09's BuildRows turns out NOT to append extraRows for DNT or detail-off visitors, LP-05 stops and asks the lead rather than working around it. =================================================================== 12. PARKED (do not plan or build) =================================================================== #236 tracking pixels and #240 selling from the page. The registry slug linkspage.tracking_pixels stays unused.
design.fixes:
BINDING NOTES FOR PLANNER 3's ITEMS AND FOR THE MERGED ORDER

1. DOCS-LAST RULE (this makes the merged order workable). Almost every item touches docs/DATABASE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, PRE_LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md or .github/HANDOFF.md. Those documentation files are left out of the clash analysis. Each builder makes its documentation edits as the last step of its item, after the code is final. The lead runs those last steps one at a time (never two builders in the same doc file at once) and re-reads the file before committing. Code, SQL, test, workflow and translation-seed files ARE covered by the clash analysis.
2. INSIDE A BATCH. In batches B1–B11, items share no code files and can run side by side. In the LinksPage batches B12–B17, the items share linkspage_manage.php, the renderer, the resolver and the edit page, so each "why" says "in order": build and commit them one after another inside the batch, never at the same time.
3. HANDOFF LOCATION. From HK-01 (the first item of B1) onwards, the handoff is .github/HANDOFF.md. Every builder writes its row there. Builders in the in-flight batch (FIX-183, LP-11, LP-10, LP-12) write to .claude/HANDOFF.md, and HK-01 starts only after all four have committed.
4. NUMBERS. Reserved here: migration 042 (SX-196), 043 (SX-212); seed 057 (SX-212), 058 (SX-210), 059 (SX-205); schema 044 (SX-212). Next free: migration 044, seed 060, schema 045. Stored procedures (web/_sql/procedures/*.sql) have no migration number: they DROP and re-CREATE themselves and are re-imported as they stand. Any item that changes one must add a line to docs/DEPLOYMENT.md and PRE_LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md saying "re-import web/_sql/procedures/<file> on every existing database".
5. DIRECT-ACCESS GUARD PATTERN after SX-198. Every new PHP library file written by any later item (PF-*, LP-*) must use the new guard, never the old basename() comparison. SX-198's unit test fails the build if the old pattern appears anywhere in web/ outside _libraries. The new pattern:
   $g2mlGuardScriptPath = (string) ($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] ?? '');
   if ($g2mlGuardScriptPath !== '' && realpath($g2mlGuardScriptPath) === realpath(__FILE__)) { header('Location: https://go2my.link'); exit; }
   unset($g2mlGuardScriptPath);
   (Note that realpath('') returns the current folder, which is why the empty check is there.)
6. EMAIL TEST SEAM. SX-212 adds $GLOBALS['g2ml_email_send_override'] to g2ml_sendEmail(): a callable ($to, $subject, $body, $headers): bool used instead of mail(). LP-18 must reuse it, not add a second one.
7. ATTEMPT COUNTING. SX-212 creates tblFormAttempts (schema 044) for site-wide forms. LP-27 still creates its own tblLinksPageAttempts as planner 2 designed; that table is deleted along with its page. Two small tables are intended. Neither may count attempts through tblActivityLog, because that log skips Do-Not-Track visitors.
8. CACHE HEADERS. SX-213 sends "Cache-Control: no-store, private" and "Pragma: no-cache" from page_init whenever a user is signed in, and always on the admin component. LP-26's later "public, max-age" policy for lnks.page applies only when no session is active, so the two never conflict. LP-26 must keep SX-213's rule for signed-in requests.
9. PROCEDURE ERRORS after SX-197. Neither stored procedure has a catch-all error handler any more. A database error reaches PHP, where dbCallProcedure() logs the MySQL message and returns false. Callers treat false as "database error" and an empty result as "ran out of attempts".
10. ISSUE COMMENTS. Every reused issue gets the issue_comment given in its item. When an item's commit lands, the lead also posts the commit reference and closes the issue once the work is merged, as usual.
11. DEV-TEAM PLUGIN (decision 18, written into the rules by HK-01). The plugin stays in use, but where its approach differs from this project's rules, the project's stricter rules win. Its commits never land on the working branch directly: it runs only on its own branch or worktree. The lead brings any useful result across as a normal one-issue, one-commit change after the cross-system review loop. The plugin never pushes. ci-medic runs only with autofix=off. Review, security and docs modes always run in report-only mode.

PF-01.title: Pricing engine switch becomes environment-aware (alpha first, production never by accident)
PF-01.plan:
GOAL: the pricing engine (and usage metering) can only be on in environments the owner has listed, so switching it on for the alpha site cannot affect production on the shared database. Read design section 2 first; it is the specification.

STEP 1 — web/_functions/pricing.php
(a) Add `_g2ml_pricingCurrentEnvironment(): string` next to _g2ml_pricingReadSetting(): if isset($GLOBALS['g2ml_pricing_environment_override']) and is_string → return it (test seam, documented like the other overrides); elseif function_exists('g2ml_getEnvironment') → return (string) g2ml_getEnvironment(); elseif defined('G2ML_ENVIRONMENT') → return (string) G2ML_ENVIRONMENT; else return ''.
(b) Add PURE `_g2ml_pricingEnvironmentAllowed(string $currentEnvironment, mixed $activeEnvironmentsSetting): bool`: if !is_string($activeEnvironmentsSetting) return false; explode on ',', trim, strtolower each; keep only values in ['alpha','beta','local','production'] (full if/else loops, no array_filter closures with arrows); return true only when $currentEnvironment !== '' and in_array($currentEnvironment, $kept, true). Docblock: why '*' is ignored, why production must be spelled out, why '' means off.
(c) g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled(): inside the try, compute $masterOn = _g2ml_pricingSettingIsOn(_g2ml_pricingReadSetting(G2ML_PRICING_SETTING_MASTER, '0')); $environment = _g2ml_pricingCurrentEnvironment(); $environmentOn = _g2ml_pricingEnvironmentAllowed($environment, _g2ml_pricingReadSetting('billing.active_environments', '')); $enabled = ($masterOn === true && $environmentOn === true). When $masterOn is true and $environmentOn is false, error_log one line: '[Go2My.Link] INFO: pricing — billing.pricing_engine_enabled is on but environment "<env>" is not listed in billing.active_environments — the engine is OFF here.' PF-01.new_issue_title: 🌍 [Pricing] Make the pricing engine switch environment-aware so enabling it for alpha can never affect production
PF-01.new_issue_body:
## What and why

All three sites (go2my.link, g2my.link, lnks.page) and every environment (alpha, beta, production) share one database. The pricing engine's master switch is a single row in that database, so turning it on to test on the alpha site would turn it on for production customers at the same moment.

The code already knows which environment it is running in (page_init.php works it out from the site address). This change adds a second setting that lists the environments the engine may run in, seeded to `alpha` only. The engine is on in a request only when both the master switch and that list say so. The same rule applies to usage metering. Owner decision 6 in #243.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New System setting `billing.active_environments` (seed 030 + migration 027), seeded `alpha`, with a plain description.
- [ ] `g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled()` is true only when `billing.pricing_engine_enabled` is on AND the current environment is in the list. An unknown environment, an empty list, a name that is not alpha/beta/local/production, or `*` all mean OFF.
- [ ] Usage metering (`g2ml_pricingMeterUsage()`) obeys the same rule.
- [ ] When the master switch is on but the environment is not listed, one log line says so.
- [ ] Unit tests cover the pure list check and the combined switch; existing pricing and feature-gate tests updated and green.
- [ ] docs/DATABASE.md and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md explain the two-part rule and how to widen the list later.

## Security and privacy

Fail safe: anything the code cannot recognise leaves the engine off. Production must be named explicitly to be included.

## Dependencies

None. Relates to #180 (engine scaffold) and #243 (decisions).

PF-02.new_issue_title: 🔢 [Pricing] Give LinksPage features a number where one fits (placeholder values), add the missing slugs, and stop a blank limit meaning unlimited
PF-02.new_issue_body:
## What and why

Owner decision 4 (#243): a feature gets a number where one fits (scheduled links, password-protected pages, uploads, email captures per month, pages per member), with 'unlimited' allowed; pure yes/no features stay yes/no. Decision 28: the per-plan numbers seeded now are placeholders, and the owner sets the real ones in the plan admin before launch. Decision 29: one avatar per page never counts towards the image limit.

Converting the LinksPage rows safely needs one fix first: the resolver treats a limit row that has no number and is not flagged unlimited as unlimited. That would silently open every converted feature to every plan. After this change a blank number means 0, and only the explicit flag means unlimited.

## What changes

- Converted to numbers: `linkspage.scheduled_links` (per page), `linkspage.password_protect` (pages per organisation), `linkspage.image_upload` (images per organisation, avatars not counted), `linkspage.embeds` (per page), `linkspage.tracking_pixels` (per page); `linkspage.lead_capture` becomes a monthly allowance.
- New: `linkspage.pages_per_member`, `linkspage.template_upload`.
- `linkspage.all_templates` switched off for Free (decision 13).
- Tier rows added for `analytics.retention_days`, `analytics.geo_country` and `analytics.export_csv`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A limit row with no number and no unlimited flag resolves to 0 (unit test).
- [ ] Seed 023 and seed 018 updated for fresh installs; migration 028 converts existing databases, touching only rows still in the old shape, and is safe to run twice.
- [ ] The seeds, docs and pre-launch checklist say the numbers are placeholders.
- [ ] Integration tests prove the per-plan numbers through `g2ml_featureLimit()`.

## Security and privacy

Fail safe: nothing becomes unlimited unless the flag says so. No new data is collected.

## Dependencies

PF-01 (same file).

PF-03.new_issue_title: 🛠️ [Pricing] Plan-and-pricing admin backend: edit tiers, features, per-plan values and exceptions in one place, with an audit log
PF-03.new_issue_body:
## What and why

Owner decisions 2, 3 and 5 (#243): no plan feature is hard-coded; tiers can be created, renamed, reordered and retired; features can be added; every plan value and per-organisation exception is set from an admin screen; every change is logged.

There are two places that hold plan values today: the feature registry (tblFeatures / tblTierFeatures) and the older columns on tblSubscriptionTiers, which the code still reads while the pricing engine is off. The owner wants one place to edit. This library makes the registry the source and rewrites the old columns in the same database transaction, so the two can never disagree. A drift check catches anything edited by hand and a repair action puts it right.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `web/_functions/tier_admin.php` is the only code that writes tiers, features, per-tier values and exceptions.
- [ ] Every write is one transaction that includes an audit row in the new `tblTierAdminAudit` table (schema 038, migration 030); if the audit row cannot be written the change is rolled back.
- [ ] Saving a value that has a legacy column updates the column in the same transaction; column names come only from the existing whitelist.
- [ ] A new tier grants nothing until configured (explicit zeros on both paths).
- [ ] Retiring a tier refuses for the fallback plan and moves organisations to a replacement in the same transaction.
- [ ] Drift check and repair; per-organisation exceptions (grant / deny / set / adjust) can be created and switched off, never deleted.
- [ ] Yes/no features can be converted to numbers with a chosen number for plans that had 'yes'; legacy features cannot be converted.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests; JSON schemas for the audit snapshot and the new activity-log keys; docs.

## Security and privacy

GlobalAdmin only (checked on the server). The audit table holds the acting admin's user id and row snapshots of plan data, no customer personal data, and is never purged.

## Dependencies

PF-02 (registry shape). Screens follow in the next issue.

PF-04.new_issue_title: 🖥️ [Pricing] Admin screens for tiers, features and the plan matrix (GlobalAdmin only)
PF-04.new_issue_body:
## What and why

Owner decisions 2, 3 and 5 (#243). With the backend in place, the owner needs screens to create, rename, reorder and retire tiers, add and edit features (choosing yes/no, a number, or a monthly allowance), and set every plan's value in a grid. All under the admin site at `/platform`, visible and usable only by a GlobalAdmin.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pages: `/platform` (overview with drift warning and repair), `/platform/tiers`, `/platform/features`, `/platform/matrix`.
- [ ] Every page checks GlobalAdmin on the server and every form carries a CSRF token, namespaced per row so multi-row pages work (#147).
- [ ] Forms escape output once, use `formField()` with raw values, and need no JavaScript.
- [ ] Every string goes through `__()` and is seeded (seed 032).
- [ ] Accessible: labelled controls, table header scopes, error and status regions.
- [ ] A 'Plans and pricing' menu entry appears for GlobalAdmins only.
- [ ] Unit tests check the guard, the CSRF check and the translation keys are present on every page.

## Dependencies

PF-03 (backend).

PF-05.title: Admin screens: per-organisation exceptions, individual (personal) plans, audit log, and the engine status panel with the environment list
PF-05.plan:
GOAL: the remaining admin screens, with the same conventions as PF-04, plus (decision 26, #243 second set) the GlobalAdmin screen for giving an INDIVIDUAL a plan in their own name through the invisible personal account holder from PF-13. The person never sees an organisation; the admin sees 'Personal account of user #N'.

STEP 0 — backend addition in web/_functions/tier_admin.php: g2ml_tierAdminSetOrgTier(string $orgHandle, string $tierID, string $note, int $actorUID): array{success, error, errorCode} — the organisation must exist (SELECT orgHandle, tierID FROM tblOrganisations WHERE orgHandle = ?), the tier must exist and be active, note required (<= 2000); one transaction: UPDATE tblOrganisations SET tierID = ? WHERE orgHandle = ?; audit row actionType 'org.tier_set' (targetType 'organisation', targetKey the handle, before/after tierID) through g2ml_tierAdminWriteAudit(); commit; then g2ml_clearOrgTierCache($orgHandle) (which PF-13 extended to clear the per-user mapping cache as well) and g2ml_clearPricingCache(). Works for any organisation, including personal holders. Add 'org.tier_set' to the list of action types in the tier_admin.php header and docs/DATABASE.md.

1. pages/platform/exceptions/index.php — GET ?org=<handle>: accept either a normal handle (validated with the org handle rule in org.php) or a personal handle (g2ml_personalAccountIsPersonalHandle() from PF-13); unknown → a plain not-found alert. For a personal handle, show 'Personal account of user #<userUID>' (from personalOwnerUserUID) instead of the raw handle, never the person's email. Shows the org's tier, then its active and inactive overrides (feature, mode, value, from/until, source, note, created by, active) with a per-row 'Switch off' form ('platform_override_off_<overrideUID>'). Create form ('platform_override_create'): feature (select of active features with the type shown), mode (grant/deny/set/adjust with a plain explanation of each), value / unlimited / adjust-delta inputs, effective until (optional date), source type, note (required). A prominent note per legacy-mapped feature: 'This exception only takes effect where the pricing engine is switched on (see the engine panel); LinksPage extras take effect everywhere at once.' An org search box (exact handle) at the top.
2. pages/platform/individuals/index.php — 'Individual plans'. A search form (GET ?email=, exact match, case-insensitive, validated with g2ml_sanitiseEmail) finds one user: shows user #id, whether they are in an organisation (if so: 'This person is a member of <orgName>; the organisation''s plan applies while they are a member. A personal plan set here applies again if they leave.'), and their current personal plan: the holder's tier name, or 'Free (no personal plan)' when no holder exists. A form (CSRF 'platform_individual_plan_<userUID>') with a select of active tiers and a required note: on POST, require_once personal_account.php, call g2ml_personalAccountEnsure($userUID) (creates the holder if needed), then g2ml_tierAdminSetOrgTier(<holder handle>, $tierID, $note, $actorUID). A link 'Exceptions for this person' → /platform/exceptions?org=<urlencoded holder handle> when a holder exists. logActivity('tier_admin_individual_lookup') on a search with no email in the data. Plain note at the top: 'Use this until online billing exists (#59); billing will call the same functions.'
3. pages/platform/audit/index.php — a paginated table (50 per page, ?page=) of tblTierAdminAudit: when, who (username or 'deleted user'), action, target (personal handles shown as 'Personal account of user #N'), environment, note, and a details toggle rendered as a <details> element showing before/after as a two-column table (no JSON on screen). Filter by target type (select, GET).
4. Engine status panel on pages/platform/index.php (created by PF-04): this request's environment (g2ml_getEnvironment()), billing.pricing_engine_enabled, billing.active_environments and the effective answer of g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled() here, in a definition list; a form ('platform_engine_settings') with the master switch checkbox and four checkboxes alpha/beta/local/production, saved through g2ml_tierAdminUpdateEngineSettings(); a red warning line when production is ticked ('Production is included: the engine will resolve every customer''s plan from the registry there.'). Add a card linking to 'Individual plans'.

STRINGS: __('tieradmin.*') seeded in web/_sql/seeds/033_tier_admin_exceptions_audit_translations.sql (INSERT IGNORE). Keys include tieradmin.exceptions_heading, tieradmin.mode_grant/deny/set/adjust (+ _help), tieradmin.legacy_only_where_engine_on, tieradmin.audit_heading, tieradmin.audit_before, tieradmin.audit_after, tieradmin.engine_heading, tieradmin.engine_this_environment, tieradmin.engine_effective_on/off, tieradmin.engine_production_warning, tieradmin.individuals_heading 'Individual plans', tieradmin.individuals_search_label 'Email address of the person', tieradmin.individuals_not_found 'No account uses that email address.', tieradmin.individuals_personal_label 'Personal account of user #{id}', tieradmin.individuals_free 'Free (no personal plan)', tieradmin.individuals_member_note, tieradmin.individuals_set_plan 'Set personal plan', tieradmin.individuals_billing_note, tieradmin.individuals_saved 'Personal plan saved.'.

TESTS: extend tests/unit/tier_admin_pages_test.php to the new pages (guard, CSRF, no .php addresses); tests/unit/translation_seed_033_test.php (keys present). Integration (tests/integration/tier_admin_test.php): g2ml_tierAdminUpdateEngineSettings(['enabled' => '1', 'environments' => ['alpha','bogus']]) stores 'alpha' only and an audit row; with $GLOBALS['g2ml_pricing_environment_override'] = 'production' g2ml_pricingEngineEnabled() is false and with 'alpha' true (clear caches in between); g2ml_tierAdminSetOrgTier on a personal holder moves it to 'basic', writes an 'org.tier_set' audit row, and g2ml_getOrgTier(g2ml_entitlementOrgHandleForUser(uid, '[default]')) then answers with basic; an unknown tier or a missing note is refused and nothing changes.

DOCS (last): docs/DEPLOYMENT.md 'Switching the engine on for alpha' points at the panel; docs/DATABASE.md action type list; handoff.

Audit page shows every change with readable before/after tables, paginated and filterable
Engine panel shows this environment and the effective state, and edits the two settings through the audited backend; bogus environment names are dropped; production shows a warning
